poetryFrame.leftVertical: YOU ARE THE LIGHT THAT GUIDES MY SHADOWED PATHWAY.
poetryFrame.rightVertical: WE EXIST IN THIS MOMENT, A PERFECT AND FLEETING DREAM.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: A GLOW THAT WILL NEVER FADE AWAY.

lyrics.text: The way you light up like the moon
Whenever I enter the room
As if I am your entire world
And we're the only two
The way you try to study me
Like I'm your favorite person
And when we're lying cheek to cheek
I think I know for certain
I've never loved like this before
And I'll never love like this again
I've never been loved like this before
And I'll never be loved like this again
The way you'll break my heart in two
How will I get over you
When you decide it's time to leave
And I'll be just a memory
I've never loved like this before
And I'll never love like this again
I've never been loved like this before
And I'll never be loved like this again
